title: Pondering Pocket Cuttlefish
statement: This palm-sized cuttlefish thinks out loud in color, rippling slow waves of gold and violet across its skin while it tidies the pebbles of its dusky, kelp-lit grotto into neat little spirals. When a visitor lingers at the glass, it drifts over, studies them with its W-shaped eyes, and answers with a brand-new pattern made just for them.
